message: 後悔するより走るんだ

name: Ria
message: 「I heard from my sister that tomorrow is Synn-kun's birthday.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?! It is?!」

name: Ria
message: 「Why are even you surprised, Synn-kun?」

name: Synn
message: 「I completely forgot.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I see. So it is the day you hatched from an egg.」

name: Misa
message: 「What kind of reptile do you think he is?」

name: Ria
message: 「Nanaka-chan, don't tell me you didn't know?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「N-No, of course I knew! It's just not that big of a deal, right? So I just didn't say anything.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What a cold childhood friend you are.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sigh... My plans are... No, wait, it's in the middle of exams anyway...」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka. You're muttering complaints over there, so is your exam studying not going well?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...W-Well, yeah. Not at all. Ahaha.」

name: Misa
message: 「I don't think this is a laughing matter.」

name: Synn
message: 「This choice is blatantly wrong, right?」

name: Azel
message: 「Indeed.」

name: Synn
message: 「In other words, this looks like four choices, but it's actually three.」

name: Azel
message: 「Pointless.」

name: Synn
message: 「It's a huge help for us, though, since there's one less option.」
What I'm teaching Azel are so-called test-taking techniques.
Honestly, you could hardly call it proper exam prep. Still, at this point, there's no helping it.

name: Synn
message: 「Also, this one and this one are pretty similar choices, right? In that case, there's a high chance the right answer is one of the two.」

name: Azel
message: 「Why is that?」

name: Synn
message: 「Mixing in confusing choices that are close to the right answer makes it easier to trick people, after all」

name: Azel
message: 「So if there are two similar choices mixed into a four- or three-option question, there is a high probability that one of them is the correct answer」

name: Synn
message: 「That's right」

name: Synn
message: 「You shouldn't be hiding a photobook under your notebook and looking at it」

name: Azel
message: 「Gah」

name: Synn
message: 「Next, let's check your kanji」

name: Azel
message: 「You put your all into everything, don't you」

name: Synn
message: 「Do I?」

name: Azel
message: 「Putting your all into things while neglecting your own studies. You're an idiot」

name: Synn
message: 「I might actually be better at studying than you, Azel」

name: Azel
message: 「Shut up. I never needed human studies in the first place」
Could it be that Azel isn't human either?
Even if that's the case, there are both angels and demons on the Student Council, demons working at soba shops and beef bowl restaurants, and even demons hitting on girls around town.
Besides, I'm a Demon Lord myself and even have a familiar, so it's a bit late to be surprised now.

name: Synn
message: 「If I look like I'm putting my all into things, it might just be because there's nothing I can do half-heartedly」

name: Azel
message: 「How clumsy」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, if you cut corners, you end up regretting it, right? I don't want to have any regrets. That's why I do everything I can」

name: Azel
message: 「Even for the sake of others?」

name: Synn
message: 「Nope. I'm definitely an egoist. When other people look like they're having fun, I have fun too, so in the end, it's all for my own sake」

name: Azel
message: 「Idiot」

name: Synn
message: 「Saying it with such certainty, huh」

name: Melilot
message: 「Here you go」

name: Azel
message: 「Thank you」
When Melilot-san served the black tea, a natural word of thanks slipped from Azel's lips.
Azel's rough edges have really smoothed out, too.

name: Melilot
message: 「How is your studying for the test coming along?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm. So-so.」

name: Melilot
message: 「In most cases, that means 'progress is rather sluggish,' doesn't it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Urk.」
I've been studying late into the night after getting home, though... I wonder if I can catch up.

name: Azel
message: 「Things are going smoothly on my end. I've memorized the kanji I picked out.」

name: Melilot
message: 「That is wonderful to hear.」

name: Azel
message: 「I've reached the point where I can read through the exam questions.」

name: Melilot
message: 「...That is wonderful to hear.」

name: Azel
message: 「The Leica is mine.」

name: Melilot
message: 「I am only lending it to you.」

name: Azel
message: 「I just made a few mistakes.」
Saying that, Azel took a sip of the black tea.

name: Azel
message: 「This is good.」

name: Melilot
message: 「I tried out a new blend.」

name: Synn
message: 「Let's see.」
It has a mysterious taste.

name: Synn
message: 「Sure is different from brewing with a used-up tea bag...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Doesn't it feel as though your fatigue has melted away?」

name: Azel
message: 「Indeed.」

name: Synn
message: 「I feel like my sleepiness is fading too」

name: Melilot
message: 「I changed the blend for the two of you, since you are tired from studying for your tests. It seems to be working.」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, what is!?」

name: Melilot
message: 「The secret ingredient, of course.」

name: Azel
message: 「My head feels clear.」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-This doesn't have something sketchy in it or anything, right?」

name: Melilot
message: 「As I said, it's a secret ingredient」
I'd better not ask for the details.

name: Arden
message: 「Where are they?! Where the hell are they hiding?!」

name: Soltia
message: 「What are you doing in a place like this?」

name: Arden
message: 「Hey, you. Where's Ryuusei Academy?」

name: Soltia
message: 「Yes, I know it. That's the place where Pasta is being bullied by the Student Council, right?」

name: Arden
message: 「Yeah, that's it! Wait, how the hell do you know about Pasta-chan?!」

name: Soltia
message: 「More importantly, shouldn't you be worried about her safety?」

name: Arden
message: 「Oh, right. There's not a single moment to lose! Uoooooh!!」

name: Soltia
message: 「Hmph... Demons truly are filthy.」
